claims.text: The preserved repository source contains only the title '算法：不同的二叉搜索树' plus BST/dynamic-programming classification; it does not preserve whether the task asks for counting or generation, a function signature, or input bounds.

The candidate explicitly chooses the counting variant for distinct BST structures over ordered keys 1..n, defines n=0 and negative-input behavior, and uses BigInteger because no fixed-width result bound is preserved in source.
Under the candidate counting contract, partitioning by root yields independent left/right structure counts whose products sum across mutually exclusive root choices.

The implementation matches exhaustive generated tree-shape counts for n=0..8 and an independently coded closed-form oracle for n=0..50, rejects negative n, and computes the n=100 BigInteger regression exactly.
